title: Walk to THE TRUTH | Near Broadway & Downtown
description:
NOT A NEW AIRBNB—our previous listing was deleted after earning 60+ reviews! Stay in the heart of Nashville in this charming historic home in popular Wedgewood-Houston (WeHo). Walk to The TRUTH, Babu Coffee, Soho House, breweries, yoga studios, art galleries, shops, pizza, and top restaurants. Just 1 mile from Broadway and downtown. Features a fully equipped kitchen, eclectic décor, fenced yard, off-street parking, and easy access to hospitals, universities, and interstates.

The space
Welcome to The Historic WeHo House, a beautifully preserved Nashville home filled with character, warmth, and timeless charm. Guests love the bright, sun-filled rooms, soaring 12-foot ceilings, original heart pine floors, exposed brick accents, and carefully preserved architectural details throughout.

The home features three decorative fireplaces, original transoms, elegant moldings, and a welcoming entry hall that captures the beauty of a bygone era while offering modern comforts.

Private off-street parking is available behind the home, with additional free two-hour public parking directly in front for convenient guest drop-offs and quick stops.

Located in the heart of Wedgewood-Houston (WeHo), one of Nashville’s most vibrant neighborhoods, you can WALK to THE TRUTH, Nashville’s newest live music venue, along with popular restaurants, coffee shops, breweries, pizza spots, yoga studios, Pilates classes, art galleries, and local and national boutiques.

Just one mile from Broadway and downtown Nashville, The Historic WeHo House offers easy access to the city’s world-famous music, dining, and nightlife while providing a unique, comfortable, and authentic Nashville experience.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire home and yard.
